title.zh: 胡萝卜最早不是橙色的

content.zh: 最早的胡萝卜其实是紫色、黄色甚至白色的！我们现在吃的橙色胡萝卜，是16世纪荷兰人为了致敬国王而特意培育出来的哦。
content.en: The earliest carrots were actually purple, yellow, or even white! The orange carrots we eat today were specially bred by the Dutch in the 16th century to honor their king.

content.zh: 因为香蕉在努力“追光”呀！香蕉刚长出来时是垂下的，但在成熟过程中，它会逆着地心引力，朝着太阳的方向弯曲生长。
content.en: Because bananas are trying to reach the sun! Bananas start growing downwards, but as they mature, they curve upwards against gravity towards the sunlight.

title.en: Strawberries have seeds on the outside

content.zh: 草莓是唯一一种种子长在表皮外面的水果！平均一颗草莓上大概有200多颗种子，就像穿了一件长满小芝麻的红外衣。
content.en: The strawberry is the only fruit that has its seeds on the outside! An average strawberry has about 200 seeds, like wearing a red coat covered in tiny sesame seeds.

content.zh: 蜂蜜是大自然里的“防腐剂”！因为它含糖量极高，细菌在里面根本无法生存。考古学家甚至在几千年前的古埃及墓穴里发现了还能吃的蜂蜜呢！
content.en: Honey is nature's preservative! Because it has extremely high sugar content, bacteria cannot survive in it. Archaeologists even found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs thousands of years old!

content.zh: 虽然我们在厨房里把番茄当蔬菜，但从植物学上讲，番茄属于果实！因为它是由花朵发育而来，而且肚子里面装满了种子。
content.en: Although we treat tomatoes as vegetables in the kitchen, botanically, they are fruits! This is because they develop from flowers and are filled with seeds inside.
